about: Hand-made ways out of spots the ground data gets wrong (nav.py): a path that starts or ends within reach of a way's first point, at its height (or indoors when no height is given), walks the way, then on from its last point. Points are world yards: north, west, height. A way's block closes its room's floors (within its reach of the first point, between its heights) to every other search, so no way passes through the room.

ways.name: Stormwind's gryphon roost: out of its door and down the ramp to the street
